no_bluetooth.title: No Bluetooth here
no_bluetooth.description: Home Assistant can't reach a Bluetooth Classic adapter, and the clock needs one. You can still add Second Hand for its Timers sensor, but nothing will be sent to a clock.

pair_mode.title: Put the clock in pairing mode
pair_mode.description: Press and hold the blue pairing button on the back of the clock (up to 10 seconds) until the light on the front pulses orange. Then select Submit.

choose.title: Which clock?
choose.description: More than one clock is in pairing mode. Pick one, or cancel, leave only one in pairing mode and try again.

confirm.title: Pair with this clock?
confirm.description:
Found {name} ({address}).

A clock works with one device at a time, so pairing it here disconnects it from anything it was paired with, such as an Echo. Select Submit to pair.

timers.title: Which timers should this clock show?
timers.description: Select the voice assistants and timer helpers you want to show on this clock.

error.nothing_picked: Pick at least one voice assistant or timer helper.
error.not_found: No clock in pairing mode was found. Check that its light pulses orange and that it's within range of this Home Assistant's Bluetooth adapter, then try again.
error.pair_failed: Pairing didn't work. Put the clock back in pairing mode, move it closer to the adapter, and try again.

progress.search: Looking for a clock in pairing mode (up to 30 seconds)…
progress.pair: Pairing with the clock. This can take a few minutes…

abort.already_configured: This clock is already set up in this Home Assistant.
abort.no_bluetooth: Home Assistant can't reach a Bluetooth Classic adapter, and the clock needs one. In a container, check host networking and the host's /run/dbus mount.

init.title: Which timers should this clock show?
init.description: Select the voice assistants and timer helpers you want to show on this clock.

error.nothing_picked: Pick at least one voice assistant or timer helper.

assist_timers_unsupported.title: Voice timers aren't showing on the clock
assist_timers_unsupported.description: A Home Assistant update changed how voice timers work, so Second Hand can't read them. Timers from timer helpers still show. Check for a Second Hand update, or open an issue.
